name: Run HumanFlow AI
description: Open a real website, establish access or request login approval, then ask the user to choose a 1–5 human audit depth before testing.
prompt: Use the installed humanflow-ai Synapse skill. Ask for target URL only if it cannot be inferred from the user's request. Open the real website and establish access, seeking permission for necessary signup/login. Only AFTER site access is established, stop and present the five audit levels 1–5, awaiting the user's choice; then execute with real browser evidence and honest blocked/not-tested states.
